protocol:
1. Arrange the bench with labeled reaction tubes on ice in a green ice bucket, tube racks, an adjustable single-channel micropipette, disposable tips in a blue tip rack, and PCR reaction tubes.

2. Attach a disposable pipette tip from the blue tip rack to the adjustable micropipette.

3. Retrieve a labeled chilled tube from the ice bucket with a gloved hand.

4. Dispense liquid with the micropipette into an open small PCR reaction tube held in the gloved hand.

5. Place the handled tube back into a tube rack or onto ice to keep it organized and chilled.

6. Repeat the liquid transfer for additional labeled tubes, taking each chilled tube from the ice bucket and dispensing into small PCR reaction tubes with the micropipette.

7. Change to a new disposable pipette tip from the blue tip rack during the repeated transfers.

8. Hold each filled PCR reaction tube and press the cap closed with gloved fingers.

9. Transfer the capped PCR reaction tubes to a benchtop mini centrifuge with a blue rotor.

10. Briefly centrifuge the capped PCR reaction tubes in the mini centrifuge.

11. Remove the centrifuged PCR reaction tubes from the mini centrifuge.

12. Carry the prepared PCR reactions to the Bio-Rad T100 thermal cycler.

13. Open the Bio-Rad T100 thermal cycler lid and place the prepared PCR reactions into the thermal cycler block.

14. Close the Bio-Rad T100 thermal cycler lid.

15. Use the T100 touchscreen to select the PCR run protocol, set the reaction volume to 25 µL, and start the thermal cycling run.
